$comment: contract-version 0.1.0 — initial durable-workspace snapshot/restore contract. Single-sources the R2 snapshot/restore mechanism (controlplane internal/workspacedata + the box userdata systemd timer) as a PROVIDER-AGNOSTIC durability SSOT: the box-facing + CP-side env surface, the persisted-path set, the tar+zstd archive format, the per-workspace object-store key scheme, the presign TTLs, and the snapshot cadence — constants currently duplicated across controlplane Go. Durability rides object storage (Cloudflare R2), NOT per-provider block volumes, so the compute provider (aws/hetzner/gcp/local/molecules-server) is irrelevant to whether /workspace survives instance recreate.
title: Durable Workspace Data (Snapshot/Restore) Contract
description: SSOT JSON-Schema (draft 2020-12) for the durable-workspace snapshot/restore mechanism. A workspace's durable agent state — everything under `persisted_paths`, INCLUDING the mailbox kernel's /workspace/.molecule — is periodically archived (tar+zstd) to object storage via a presigned PUT and restored via a presigned GET BEFORE the runtime container mounts /workspace, so state survives instance recreate / auto-heal on ANY compute provider. The SDK owns this SHAPE + constants; the snapshot/restore IMPLEMENTATION lives in molecule-controlplane (box userdata timer + workspacedata.Service), and molecule_runtime's durability guard READS the persisted-path + snapshot-URI signals to credit snapshot-durability. This contract owns the PROTOCOL; the per-workspace on/off SELECTOR (`data_persistence`) is owned by provision-request and only cross-referenced here.

_doc.description: Free-form documentation block (array of prose lines). Not machine-validated.

implementation_owner.description: Owns the snapshot/restore IMPLEMENTATION: workspacedata.Service (presign + key scheme) + the box userdata systemd timer + restore snippet. No per-runtime reimplementation.

durability_guard_consumer.description: Reads persisted_paths + box_env.snapshot_uri to credit snapshot-durability in the in-container durability guard (mailbox_dir.verify_durability).

enable.description: The master gate. The mechanism is inert (no URIs injected) until this env is truthy.

default_today.description: The CURRENT code default (ships dark). Pinned to the real constant so a drift-gate catches divergence.

target_default.description: The intended end-state: R2 snapshot durability ON by default for every provider. Flipping default_today→target_default is a rollout gated on `default_on_gated_on`.

default_on_gated_on.description: Prerequisites that MUST be met before default_today may become target_default.

selector.description: The per-workspace on/off choice. SSOT lives in provision-request (data_persistence); cross-referenced here so the values are not redefined.

auto_default.description: What 'auto' resolves to today: desktop-control ON, others follow the org flag.

box_env.description: The ONLY two vars injected onto the box. Presigned single-object URLs — the box never holds object-store credentials (the presign prefix + short expiry are the auth boundary).

restore_uri.description: Presigned GET of the last snapshot; consumed by the box restore step at boot.

snapshot_uri.description: Presigned PUT of the fixed latest key; consumed by the box snapshot timer.

cp_env.description: CP-side only (Infisical projection, read by workspacedata service build). NEVER on the wire / never on the box. Any absent → feature nil (off).

persisted_paths.description: The exact set archived + restored. /workspace/.molecule (mailbox kernel state) is covered transitively by /workspace. This is the SSOT the userdata tar path-list renders from and the runtime guard checks its base against.

excluded_paths.description: Paths deliberately NOT persisted, with the reason (so nobody 'helpfully' adds them).

key_scheme.description: Per-workspace object key. v1 keeps ONE last-known-good image overwritten in place (no history — see open.retention).

snapshot_put_max_seconds.description: 7d — the S3 SigV4 presign ceiling; the timer reuses the boot-injected PUT until expiry/recreate.

cadence.description: Box snapshot timer. PERIODIC — state written since the last snapshot is lost on a hard recreate (weaker than a live block volume). See open.durability_note.

restore_ordering.description: The restore snippet runs BEFORE `docker run` bind-mounts /workspace, so the container sees restored data. Non-negotiable ordering invariant.

durability_signal.description: What the in-container runtime guard checks to CREDIT snapshot-durability (so it does not false-warn EPHEMERAL on a boot-disk provider whose /workspace is R2-backed).

disabled_marker.description: Dropped by a failed restore; the timer honors it to refuse snapshotting an empty tree over a good backup.

safety.description: Data-loss guards already in the mechanism (pinned so a refactor can't silently drop them).

open.description: Known-open edges (P3 / prerequisites). Not shape; documented so consumers and the rollout track them.
